title: Moving a Booked Slot: Allowance, Notice and Fee by Fulfilment Service
content:
On an order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment the allowance is the number of times the slot may be moved
at the customer's request before a fee applies, the notice figure is the hours of notice needed to move the slot
without a charge, and the reschedule fee is the charge to move the slot beyond the allowance. Each fulfilment service
sets its own.

| Fulfilment service | Moves allowed at the customer's request | Notice needed, hours | Reschedule fee |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | 3 | 12 | 0.00 |
| Store Pickup Hold | 2 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Threshold Delivery | 2 | 24 | 35.00 |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | 2 | 48 | 45.00 |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | 2 | 48 | 75.00 |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | 3 | 72 | 125.00 |

## The allowance counted out (hypothetical moves)

On Threshold Delivery the allowance stands at 2 moves and the fee at 35.00. A first move and a second move at the
customer's request fall inside that allowance; a third such move falls beyond it, and the figure that attaches to a
move beyond the allowance on that service is 35.00. On Standard Parcel Delivery the allowance is wider, at 3 moves,
and the figure attaching beyond it is nil.

## The notice figure across the services

The notice needed runs from 0 hours on Store Pickup Hold, through 12 hours on Standard Parcel Delivery and 24 hours
on Threshold Delivery, to 48 hours on Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away and on White Glove Delivery and
Installation, and 72 hours on Business Dock and Freight Delivery. A move made with fewer hours of notice than the
service's figure has not been given the notice the service asks for.
